title: Harmonices Mundi (Latin, 1619)
author: Johannes Kepler
description: Johannes Kepler explores harmony through geometry, music and the structure of the heavens. This Latin edition offers direct access to a work connecting mathematical proportion with the search for order in planetary motion.
editionNote: Curator-supplied PDF and EPUB from the organised ebook collection. Source text obtained from the Internet Archive (https://archive.org/details/ioanniskepplerih00kepl).
